findings.reason: a node repairing the review would assert a diagnosis over eight names where the record supports four and would find four names whose checks are absent, so the evidence sentence and the eight-name done-when clause have to be restated over the names that actually carry the checks.
findings.text: §11 states "The newest stored name review of every one of the eight renamed names, accepted or not, answers the same two source-support checks above their 0.5 cutoff, between 0.89 and 0.96 on one and between 0.79 and 0.86 on the other". Read from the live `StandardNameReview` record, the newest review per name gives `source_fidelity_unsupported_qualifier` / `over_qualified_modifier` as: `accumulated_ammonia_deuterated_equivalent_electron_count` 0.90 / 0.82, `accumulated_carbon_equivalent_electron_count_due_to_gas_injection` 0.94 / 0.86, `accumulated_deuterated_methane_prefill_equivalent_electron_count` 0.96 / 0.83, `accumulated_ethane_equivalent_electron_count` 0.93 / 0.82 — and nothing for `accumulated_ammonia_equivalent_electron_count` (2026-11-15T18:54:51), `accumulated_argon_equivalent_electron_count_due_to_gas_injection` (19:00:09, zero checks recorded), `accumulated_deuterium_equivalent_electron_count_due_to_gas_injection` (23:44:48) and `accumulated_neon_equivalent_electron_count` (17:26:49), whose newest reviews predate the check set and carry no such check. So the range is 0.90–0.96 and 0.82–0.83 over four names, not 0.89–0.96 and 0.79–0.86 over eight; and because the other four have no such check, §11's done-when clause "the eight renamed names are in that class and, reviewed again, each has both source-support checks below cutoff" has no reading the worker can take from the stored record — four vacuous passes and no score to move below cutoff, exactly the "no other check is above its cutoff on all eight" sentence that also holds vacuously for them

findings.reason: without a planted equivalent-electron name the new clause cannot be shown to fire, and the clause is the only place the 48 waiting renames are measured, so a census regression would pass the section.
findings.text: §6's first bullet adds "every live name whose source states an equivalent-electron counting basis … carries `equivalent_electron` in its identifier or is listed by name with the source evidence for leaving it", but the bullet's negative controls at the end of the list plant only a divergent family and two operator names; no name carrying such a basis is planted, so a census that reports the equivalent-electron cohort as empty (or never measures it) satisfies the clause silently, and the "or is listed with the source evidence for leaving it" escape lets every member of the cohort be listed without the guard ever firing
